resume_instruction: Read README.md, run verify_literature.py, then execute round next_round. Append to SOURCES.csv; never renumber. Write ROUND_0N_FINDINGS.md; update this file; re-run the verifier; commit.

3.theme: Verify the cocycle, restore the lock claim, and pin DDE numerics
targets: F10 CARRY-OVER (highest value, lowest cost): test the cocycle composition law Phi(t+s) = Phi(t,theta_s w) Phi(s,w) on the AIEF history-tangent operator at one frozen seed from runs/5a9f093a2fe0. Either outcome is publishable; only the unexamined case is not.

Restore REJ-LOCK-03 against the published implicit solvability condition for phase-locked frequency in Park & Lefebvre (LIT-0018) and Jolly et al. (LIT-0028), instead of a bare numerical zero-sum test.
Anchor EMP-AIEF14-03 (the rho in {0.50..2.00} sweep) to external literature; it currently has none.
Close LEAD-0004 (Strogatz 2000), LEAD-0005 (MacKinnon & Webb intervals), LEAD-0006 (lexicographic Jacobians for reachability).
DDE numerics: method of steps, discontinuity propagation, correct treatment of history at a split event. Bears directly on AIEF_1_4_SPLIT_STATE_ABLATION.
Lean 4 / Mathlib: state the rank-incidence theorem in a form Mathlib can consume, so LEAN-CF-01 generalizes beyond C_{2,7} (Round 1 F4).
Reproducibility standards for the Stage 7 CI gates; justify the two-tier tolerance (0-ULP on discrete P_*, bounded tolerance on continuous DDE arrays) with LIT-0012/0013/0014.
Nonsmooth AD tooling that could compute lexicographic derivatives for the CF block in practice (LIT-0022).

5.theme: Network topology, null models, and competing metrics
targets: Motif null-model standards beyond Milo 2002: degree-preserving rewiring and significance thresholds, to restate or retire REJ-K3-04 (Round 1 F3).
Persistent homology / topological persistence as an alternative to thresholded-graph D_bar.
Network knockout and intervention methodology, to place the ablation design against the literature standard.

known_gaps: All retrievals are metadata- or abstract-level. No paywalled full text was opened; no numbered theorem is attributed to a source that was not read.
No forward-citation or citation-graph analysis. The field map is search-driven and therefore recall-limited.
The repository cites no external literature anywhere in its 2,760-file tree. This inbox is the project's first bibliography, not a completion of an existing one.

OPEN (round 2, F10): it is unverified whether the AIEF history-tangent operator satisfies the cocycle composition law. 'Cocycle' is an identity, not a name. This is the single largest unresolved item in the inbox.
Cameron, Gelbach & Miller (LIT-0026) content is second-hand via LIT-0002; its own abstract was not read.
The bootstrap variant used by AIEF_1_3_paired_statistics_updated.py is still unconfirmed by code reading (validity is settled, description is not).
EMP-AIEF14-03 and REJ-LOCK-03 remain without a defensible external anchor.
